meta_title: Baghici Creative Technologies | Tech Partners for Founders
meta_description: Two 22-year-old builders from Romania. We turn business problems into working tech for founders: CRMs, landing pages, automation, web and mobile apps.

hero.h1: You bring the problem. We ship the system.
hero.sub: We solve business problems with tech, systems and creativity. CRMs, landing pages, automation and apps for founders who move fast, built by two digital natives who do too.

about.heading: Two people. Two superpowers.
about.intro: We're 22 and grew up online. We learn new tools the week they drop, move fast and stay hungry. Our age isn't a footnote. It's our edge.

people.name: Teodora
people.bio: Teodora loves building businesses. She's driven and set on leading an amazing team. She believes in sales done right: ethical, value-driven, never pushy. She blends the technical with the creative, so your idea makes sense to builders and buyers alike.

people.name: Gabi
people.bio: Gabi is the team's builder and a systems thinker to the core. Hand over a messy problem with no textbook answer and Gabi comes back with an unconventional fix that works. Problem-solver, through and through.

about.together: Teodora sees the business. Gabi sees the system. You get both in the same conversation: a plan that sells, tech that holds up, nothing lost in translation.

philosophy.heading: Purpose meets profit.
philosophy.body: We've built history games for the National History Museum of Romania. We research how AI can improve education. And we ship mobile games while a trend is still hot. That's not a contradiction. It's the point. Impact work taught us to create long-term value. The games market taught us speed, monetization and how cash flow really works. Your business needs both. We bring both.

pillars.label: Purpose
pillars.line: Digital projects for education and culture, like our work with MNIR.

pillars.label: Lab
pillars.line: Internal R&D testing how AI could help close the public-private education gap.

pillars.label: Profit
pillars.line: Trend-driven mobile games, shipped fast. Our pragmatic growth engine.

services.eyebrow: What we can build for you
services.heading: Less busywork. More business.
services.intro: You don't need a bloated proposal. You need the fix for your bottleneck. Here's what we build, and what it does for you.

items.title: Custom CRMs
items.benefit: Stop running sales out of spreadsheets and DMs. Get a CRM shaped around how you actually sell.

items.title: High-converting landing pages
items.benefit: Pages with one job: turning visitors into leads, sign-ups or sales. Fast, clear and mobile-first.

items.title: Automation systems
items.benefit: Hand the repetitive work to software. Get your hours back for the work only you can do.

items.title: Custom internal systems
items.benefit: When off-the-shelf software doesn't fit, we build the tool your operations actually need.

items.title: Web & mobile apps
items.benefit: From first prototype to an app in your customers' hands. Built by a team that ships its own products.

work.heading: Proof, not promises.
work.intro: Impact work, our own products and client projects. Different worlds, same approach: understand the problem, build the system, ship it.

items.title: Interactive history games
items.line: Interactive games that make history click for kids.

items.title: Smart warehouse system
items.line: A custom warehouse management system, built for the museum.

projects.name: Two Hands
projects.subtitle: Client work for a massage studio

lab.heading: Rethinking school, one prototype at a time.
lab.intro: Our internal R&D, where we design and test AI architectures for education. The goal: show that public schooling can get better and narrow the gap with private education. Think of it as our homework.

items.title: Adaptive learning prototypes
items.line: Lab prototypes exploring AI that meets each student at their level, not the class average.

items.title: Closing the public-private gap
items.line: Internal research into how AI could give public-school students the support private schools offer.

items.title: Architectures for tomorrow's schools
items.line: Architectures we're testing in-house for AI tools that could run on public-school budgets.

final_cta.heading: Coffee's on us. Virtually, anyway.
final_cta.body: Tell us what you're building and what's slowing you down. We'll listen, ask the right questions and tell you straight what we'd build. No slides, no pressure. Worst case, you leave with fresh ideas.

footer.tagline: Tech, systems and creativity. Built in Romania by two 22-year-olds.
